Class MouseEvent

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.window.input.MouseEvent
public final class MouseEvent extends Object
Small mutable compatibility carrier for a GUI pointer and button transitions.

Lombok supplies an all-field constructor, fluent getters/setters, equality, and a diagnostic string. This carrier performs no coordinate conversion or input dispatch. Current frame dispatch uses FrameEvent; this public type remains available to callers using the original API.

      public MouseEvent(int mouseX, int mouseY, int pressedButton, int releasedButton)
      Creates a new MouseEvent instance.
      Parameters:
      mouseX - Pointer X supplied by the caller, normally in GUI units.
      mouseY - Pointer Y supplied by the caller, normally in GUI units from the top.
      pressedButton - Caller-supplied pressed-button index; callers define the absent-event sentinel.
      releasedButton - Caller-supplied released-button index; no held-state bookkeeping occurs here.
